message: v10.7.11 separates customer acquisition from physical serving capacity. Strong new Language AI releases now create a longer multi-week/month adoption wave instead of snapping toward a fixed user target in a few days. A better model can continue attracting potential customers even while datacenter utilization is at the hard 100% ceiling; excess demand becomes paused/waitlisted customers until capacity is expanded. Launch momentum scales with improvement over the player's previous models, rival frontier, brand, reputation and launch strategy. The model serving panel now shows potential customers, new demand per day and paused/waitlisted customers separately. Existing v10.7.10 hard-cap economics, Cybersecurity model-type selector fix, interaction-stability fix, Sandbox serving controls, licensing and human-voice tutorial remain included.
